Back to exercise collectionBox jump
Exercise · Intermediate

Box jump

Develop controlled jumping and landing ability.

Low stable box

How to approach it

  1. Use a low, stable platform in a clear area.
  2. Jump only to a height you can land on securely with both feet.
  3. Step down and reset between attempts.

Progress and scaling

Use step-ups as a lower-impact alternative. Do not increase height if landings are unstable.
